templates.text: Turn in 5 quests with a guildie nearby in your group.
Gain a level with a guildie nearby in your group.
Run a dungeon with {X}: their Pinto quest asks them to run one with you.
Run a dungeon with {X}, who's active but rarely plays with you.
Run a dungeon with a guildie whose gear is low for their level.
Turn in a quest marked Elite or Group with at least 2 guildies nearby in your group.
Ask {X} for help: they often bring guildies together. Quest or do a dungeon for 10 minutes with {X} in your group.
Bring {X} and {Y} together: they've never grouped. Quest or do a dungeon for 10 minutes with both in your group.
Quest for 10 minutes with a new member in your group.
Group with a guildie for 10 minutes on 3 different days this week.
Run 2 dungeons with at least 3 other guildies this week.
Run a dungeon with a full party of guildies.
Invite someone new to the guild, and see them join.
Use /dance with 3 guildies nearby in your group, all within one minute.
Be jolly together: use /cheer, /clap or /congratulate with 3 guildies nearby in your group, all within one minute. Any mix counts.
